stemMd: A publisher printed fewer copies of each new title this year, yet its total number of newly printed books rose. Which fact best resolves the apparent discrepancy?

options.label: D
options.textMd: The publisher released sufficiently more new titles this year.

explanationMd: Total copies depend on both copies per title and number of titles. A sufficient rise in the number of new titles can outweigh a decrease in the print run for each title.

distractorRationale.c: Reviews of older titles do not explain newly printed book totals.
distractorRationale.e: Price is not a component of copy count.
distractorRationale.a: An office move has no stated connection to production volume.
distractorRationale.b: Paper thickness does not change the number of copies.
